what_this_is: methods whose BEHAVIOUR was measured on the running original with read-only /proc reads, rather than modelled from static evidence. The ledger's last stage was pinned at 0 because nothing ever fed it: the generator writes behavior_status = not-tested and has no registration path.
what_does_not_qualify: host emulation of the binary (Unicorn) and local fixtures - that is the stage's own definition. doubleTimeUnlocked is therefore deliberately absent (derived and emulated, never measured running), as is any ivar pointer read that is not a method's behaviour: the PaintMixUI.world round trip is recorded in the artifact but counts as an identity check, not as a method here.
how_to_extend: add a record only when a specific measurement of the RUNNING original can be pointed at, with the build hash it was taken on and an explicit boundary statement.

methods.measured_on: the day fraction, 100 samples over three full cycles
methods.boundary: modelled and reproduced (worst residual 0.0366 against the committed samples); the code that WRITES the field was not found after five static and executed routes, which is why it is measured rather than disassembled

methods.measured_on: the direction flag the running original reports, sampled with the fraction
methods.boundary: agrees with the modelled derivative at every sample except within one sample interval of a turnaround, where a sampled flag can lag; the test counts those and requires the rest to agree

methods.measured_on: the flag's live value against the clock it scales
methods.boundary: establishes the flag is set and the clock moves 20 units per real second while it is; it does NOT establish what the flag does to the simulation step rate, which the ledger records as still open

methods.measured_on: the clock's advance rate, measured in two separate sessions
methods.boundary: 20.00012 and 20.005 units per real second; its meaning as a save key is separate and not claimed here

methods.measured_on: the vector read at its modelled offset in the running original
methods.boundary: a unit vector (|v| = 1.0000), which cross-checks the offset and the copy-stub reading at once; the components' individual meanings are not claimed

methods.measured_on: the hop the walk follows at UIManager+56 in the running original
methods.boundary: resolves to an object whose isa matches the resolved paintMixUI class; a measured pointer chain, not a claim about that screen's contents

methods.measured_on: objc_msgSend on a live [InventoryItem alloc] instance in the shell32 standalone-original process (runtime-lab shell32/logs/run119.log): setSelectedSubItemIndex(0x99), then the paired getter read the value back
methods.boundary: instance is alloc-only (no initWith*), so this measures the accessor pair and not any initialization path; the call went through the runtime's own sel_registerName + objc_msgSend dispatch; dispatch itself is exercised, the field meaning is not claimed beyond the round trip

methods.measured_on: the read-back side of the same run119 round trip: 153 (0x99) after the setter, and 0 on a freshly allocated instance
methods.boundary: same alloc-only instance and standalone-original process as the setter record; two observed states (fresh=0, after set=0x99); no claim about behavior on initialized instances

note: These entries are a SUBSET of implemented_methods.json. Implementation data lives there so there is one registry; this file only records that the behaviour of each listed method was measured on the running original, with the measurement and its boundary.
